summary.zh-TW: 一整面磚塊，游標滑過的磚塊翻到背面、露出藏在後面的字母，過一下再自己翻回來；掃過一排就像拼出一段訊息。載入時會從左上角斜著翻一波示範。
summary.en: A wall of tiles where each tile the cursor crosses flips to reveal a letter on its back, then flips home after a moment; sweeping a row spells out a message. On load a diagonal wave flips across from the top left.

text.zh-TW: perspective 放在外層的牆上，所有磚塊共用同一個視點，翻轉時左右兩邊的磚塊角度不同，才有一整面牆的立體感。
text.en: Perspective sits on the wall so every tile shares one viewpoint; tiles on either side tilt differently as they flip, which makes it read as one wall.

text.zh-TW: 每塊磚有正反兩面疊在一起，背面先轉 180°；背對我們的那一面藏起來，轉到 90° 以後自然換成另一面。
text.en: Each tile stacks a front and a back rotated 180°; the face turned away is hidden, so past 90° the other face takes over.

text.zh-TW: 整面牆只綁一個 pointermove，找出游標底下是哪一塊，不必替幾十塊磚各綁事件；手指拖過去時 pointerenter 不會觸發，但這個方法可以。
text.en: One pointermove on the wall finds the tile under the pointer instead of binding dozens of handlers; it also works for a finger dragging across, where pointerenter wouldn't fire.

text.zh-TW: 翻回來之前又被碰到，只重新計時、不重播翻轉；游標在同一區來回晃時，磚塊會一直停在背面。
text.en: If a tile is touched again before flipping back, only the timer restarts; hovering around one area keeps those tiles on their back.

text.zh-TW: 示範的斜向波浪：延遲等於「列＋欄」，同一條斜線上的磚塊一起翻，看起來像從角落掃過去。
text.en: The demo's diagonal wave: delay equals row + column, so tiles on the same diagonal flip together, sweeping from the corner.
